BSC Biotechnology
With the view to provide quality professional courses in Biosciences at an affordable prices, Kaliabor college has introduced B. Sc. Biotechnology under Gauhati University from 2012. The college has sophisticated AC laboratories to provide ambient conditions for grooming young scholars to take up a career in Biotechnology. The department has highly qualified faculties and also supported by guest Teachers from Tezpur University, North Eastern Hill University, Assam Agricultural University and others.
Vision
Quality professional Courses at affordable cost for empowerment through knowledge, inclusive growth for socio-economic transformation and sustainable development.
Mission
To create man power with knowledge, competence, and creativity to face global challenges.
To empower rural youths to compete with their urban counter parts.
To create innovators in the field of biosciences.
Course
B. Sc. Biotechnology (UG Course) under Gauhati University.
